I am trying to decide between buying an Xbox or a PS4 and I don't know the difference between the two. Are there any advantages and disadvantages between the two? I don't really like the idea of having microphones and cameras being able to spy on me at home but I guess I could unplug it when I don't use to stop the creepy factor of that.

I thought about getting a joystick too so that maybe I could fly some aircraft in war games maybe. I don't know what I am doing about this equipment. Any suggestions?

If you've never gamed and are not certain if you'll enjoy it...I would say to buy a basic controller to plug into your computer and download Steam. It's going to be your easiest and cheapest way to get into gaming. Steam itself is free, it's just an application you log into to access your games. You can play offline for some of the games, but you'll be better served if you have an online connection while you play. They remember games you've purchased, so you can uninstall, reinstall, etc as much as you like to save space on your computer.

http://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=flying+sim That's a listing of some of the flight simulators they have available. It's not a genre I've been into, so I'm afraid I can't recommend much. You don't need a specialized joystick to play those games, but some people really like investing in fancy ones.

The differences between PS4 and XBox 360 are mostly that they have different buttons on the controllers. Sure, graphics are better on one than the other, but not by any huge margin. You used to get lots of Playstation or XBox exclusive games, but those days are long gone. Pricing for games and for consoles are damn near identical, and if you want to play online games, you'll have to pay each for that privilege. Lame, but it is what it is.
